description:
Our Pad apartments are thoughtfully designed to offer a comfortable and stylish living experience. Each features a cozy double bed, a well-equipped kitchenette, a luxurious ensuite bathroom, and smart storage solutions that make the most of the space—ideal for those who value convenience and modern living.

***All bills are included ***

Bundled Bills = €140
Total = €1990

Roof top terrace with panoramic views

Complimentary Social events

This exclusive co-living development is the largest of its kind in Dublin City and is located in the heart of The Liberties - one of Dublin’s most vibrant neighbourhoods. 

Liberties House is within walking distance to the City Centre and has excellent transport connections, including Luas, local buses, Dublin bike, Bleeperbike and GoCar. 

We look forward to welcoming you to Liberties House and joining our community.
